scope: Current local source review, not a production request or mail-provider readback.

frontend.contact_upload: File is encoded in browser and included as attachment name/mimeType/size/dataBase64 in submitted JSON

worker.database: D1 rfqs receives inquiry fields and source_tracking_json; attachment metadata is stored, not dataBase64
worker.notification: Current notifySales sends rendered text/html including attachment name, but no attachment content field
worker.attachment_followup: Preserve or forward the submitted file through the tested RFQ path before claiming file delivery
worker.email_response_followup: API send acceptance is not mailbox delivery; verify separately

browser.optional_entry_storage: sessionStorage first-touch URL/referrer only with analytics enabled; cleared on withdrawal
browser.submission_context: current URL/referrer/campaign/source/CTA may accompany the submitted inquiry without optional session storage
